reviews.text: The staff were very welcoming and kind to my furry son, Ghost. They were very informative and helpful and didn’t make me feel like they were trying to get rid of me and my mom. Excellent service. Highly recommended establishment.

Let me start out by saying I highly recommend this animal hospital. My story starts out with my Dog Blue a 6 year old Blue Nose Bully  who’s tooth got Chipped after being attacked few months back during an unprovoked dog attack by my neighbors dog Max .  the owner Kenny who never seemed to be able to control his dog or contain his dog in his yard or apartment it broke through the fence multiple times, and even the screen door was busted from his dog .This was Kenny who never trained his dog or even taken to a vet for its shots the dog was always starving hungry look like his ribs were showing all the time. Very sad situation . Unfortunately, his girlfriend died from OD and he basically went and started partying and selling drugs basically I lived next to a trap house and the owner kenny abused his dog and  used the dog for keeping the police And would be burglars from coming into his apartment !   So I continued monitoring the tooth until I noticed When I was brushing his teeth the pain along with discoloration In the tooth Started to turn black and his lips nodes under the jaws were swollen . My neighbor said that he would help with the veterinarian bills if I didn’t call the police as well as my hospital bills because I was injured as well  by his dog . Anyway My dog was in a tremendous amount of pain he could not to go out  without being attacked by the neighbor’s dog and the landlord wouldn’t do anything, My dog couldn’t even eat his favorite food or treats . I had to do something I could tell He was in pain so I called  the hospital told them my situation and they got me in ASAP two hours and surgery two hours to recovery and my boy was back on his feet again. Though he is very shook up highly reactive with other dogs who are aggressive now .😢 luckily I was able to pay the $1000 to  have that tooth extracted and  got his other teeth cleaned. plus they gave him a nice cocktail for the pain and he was sleeping like a baby after surgery .  The staff was very professional and attentive to his needs, and my questions were answered. I feel very confident in the establishment and Professional,and friendliness of the staff was above and beyond !
Highly recommend their services and i guess the prices were reasonable for the services provided  seemed expensive at the time  to have one tooth pulled but it turns out there are no veterinarian dentist in the Chicago area so what choice did I have let him suffer and keep me awake all night crying ? I recommend people not to get big dogs if they’re not going to spend the time and need to train them or pay to have someone train them for them to prevent situations like this from happening. 👍

Paid over $600 in visits trying to get my cats feline herpes under control. Ended up leaving with saline wash & eye wipes. Eye got significantly worse. Changed vets and went to West Loop Veterinary Care. Immediately gave him a anti viral which is what I asked for from this office and his eye is now resolved. Not to mention your appointment will always be late here and my cat is beyond stressed with travel. Ive always had to wait 20-30mins. Not pleased with treatment plan at all. I will not be back. Wish I could get a refund for my time and cat’s health this ended up costing me $900 in total from multiple visits.
They did an amazing Job to bring back Peter the third  and bartholomew the first who were flushed down the toilet when i took a massive dump

It was my first time going to this location and the staff was very helpful. All the staff were very considerate of all pets AND pet parents which was nice. The doctor was very through in explaining what treatments or tests were needed and why. They made sure my cat was taken care of gently and conforted the entire time. As a cat mom i was so anxious but this place made sure to get rid if any uncertainty I had.They were upfront with the price too which I appreciated.
Thank you so much for the five-star rating! We truly value you and your sweet cat as part of the Animal Advocate community, and we look forward to seeing you both again soon!

When I recently moved to Chicago, I was unsure where to go for my new puppy. Luckily, I live very close to this vet, but I got even luckier with the amazing care from all the vets and staff! They are so friendly from start to finish, and you can tell they truly care for our pets. We were originally assigned to Dr. MacLeish (amazing), but we also saw Dr. Clay-Smith (also amazing) on short notice when my dog needed to be seen sooner. They also call a few days later to check in, which is greatly appreciated. The only slight slight grievance I have is they are so caring and busy that sometimes it is difficult to get a hold of someone on the phone. However, if you leave a voicemail or email, they get back to you the same day or the next day, which is great. Thank you for taking such good care of my pup! P.S. Please make sure you grab the itemized receipt to submit as an invoice for your pet insurance! My other vet in another state (before we moved) had an automated system to submit to the insurance company. I do wish they had that here, but it truly is so easy to create an invoice on my end and document our deductible/reimbursements.

I can't express how amazing this place is! The staff is so kind, caring, and all around amazing! Our dog is very anxious and they are always so patient and gentle with her. We are so fortunate to have a veterinarian who we can trust.

Updates: Dr. Clay-Smith and her team are extraordinary. This is a boutique experience for your furry babies. All 4 of my babies (3 cats and a dog) have been under their care for 2 years now, and have had their dental cleanings under anesthesia. When I tell you this animal hospital is top notch, I mean it. Everything always goes so smooth and they really care about your fur babies here. The facility is huge, clean, modern, there are even cat trees mounted on the walls in the exam room. Warm blankets and churu will keep your babies happy.  I don’t take my pets care lightly and this is THE best vet in Chicago. If you are looking for QUALITY, you found it!!! Worth EVERY penny!! I’ve tried others and wasn’t impressed. Highly recommend!!

Today my 3 kitties all got their yearly checkups and bloodwork done at Animal Advocate Pet Hospital. The facility is clean, the staff are so kind, very accessible parking, and both doctors are amazing!! Dr. Clay went above and beyond to make sure my babies felt comfortable with a warm blanket to swaddle them as they got their blood drawn. Super personable team, tons of laughs and an all around incredible experience. I only want and choose the best for my fur babies.. so you know it’s true when I say, 5 stars!! Your babies will be in excellent hands.. Highly recommend!!!

We’ve been bringing our 10 y/o lab to Advocate for the last few years and have had great experiences with Dr’s MacLeish and Clay Smith! Both are extremely personable (to our dog and us) and always feel very fair in what services they recommend. Our dog is always excited for a trip to the vet, which is a great sign for us!!
Found this vet when I moved, they're super nice, they go over everything, my dog even likes going over there. Plus, parking on site, and they're affordable

Animal Advocate is amazing! The staff is always kind, patient, and happy to answer all of my questions. During our last visit, Dr. MacLeish and Julie were incredibly gentle and caring with my dog, Luna. She always leaves feeling calm and happy. I’m truly grateful for the excellent care they provide and highly recommend them.
Thank you so much for the five-star review! We're so grateful for your trust in our team at Animal Advocate Pet Hospital. We hope to see you and your pup again soon!

Thank you, Joana, and the entire team at Animal Advocate Pet Hospital for always caring for Toby with such patience and love. We know he can be a little difficult sometimes, and even so, you always take wonderful care of him!

Thank you, Joana, and the entire team at Animal Advocate Pet Hospital for always caring for Toby with such patience and love. We know he can be a little difficult at times, and yet you always take wonderful care of him!

I just cannot say enough positive things. The doctors know me and my dog. They go above and beyond. My pup is hard and going to the vet is hard for him but everyone in the office is so patient, kind, and understanding. You never feel like a bother, they are generous with their time. We are so lucky to have stumbled upon Animal Advocate.

I can’t say enough nice things about this place. Dr. MacLeish is the sweetest person. The entire staff is so nice and knowledgeable. I’ve never trusted a place more with my pets and never feel like they’re trying to rip me off which is how I felt with my last vet in the city. So beyond grateful to have found them.

Amazing! Dr. MacLeish was great. So knowledgeable about my dog’s testing and treatment. So humble and not trying to push tests and other treatments to make money which so many vets do. She even sat on the floor with my dogs and I. I really trust her. All of the other staff interacted with were friendly and kind.

My pet Oliver had the best vet "wellness check up" this week with Dr. Macleish and Joana.  He has anxiety for vets and they kept him calm, and slowly checked everything he needed. I did not feel they were trying to sell me a lot, like his previous vet. I am so grateful they are so caring with animals,  Mine is 17.5 years old!

Exceptional Care & Truly Compassionate Team

I have taken my dog to Animal Advocate Pet Hospital in Chicago on several occasions—usually when he has been sick—and every visit has been consistently outstanding. The veterinarian I worked with was extremely friendly, personable, and genuinely invested in both my dog’s health and in my experience as a pet owner. Her calm demeanor, clear explanations, and kindness made all the difference during stressful moments.

In a veterinary market that is highly saturated, this clinic truly stands out. Their quality of service, attention to detail, and thoughtful customer care set them apart. I also deeply appreciate their availability and convenient hours, which has made it far easier to get my dog seen when he needed care most.

I have returned several times because each experience has reinforced my trust in their team. I highly recommend Animal Advocate Pet Hospital to any pet owner looking for compassionate, reliable veterinary care in Chicago.

Love all of the staff here. Everyone is so kind and you can tell they really care about your animal(s) health. We bring both of our cats here and now our new puppy as well! Highly recommend, and open on Saturdays! Super easy to get an appointment or just stop by to pickup medication if needed.

Phenomenal staff, responsive, were sooo helpful. Had a baby kitten who had a nasty eye infection and congestion and their follow up was everything. Had text, phone and follow up. So grateful for this clinic. I bring strays and my cats here 👏🏼

Thank you for your 5-star rating. Knowing you had a positive experience at Animal Advocate means the world to our team and our small business! We appreciate your support and we’re always here to help. We hope to see you again soon!

I couldn't get an appt with my regular vet which turned out to be a wonderful thing to happen to me because I have found a much much better vet for all my animals! I'm an animal rescuer and I have a dog of my own and I had been going to another vet for about 20 years for all of my services. My regular vet had been taken over by a private equity firm and everything about it became awful. I hated to go there. So when I called for a same day appt, of course they didn't answer (because they are terrible) but I had been to Animal Advocate many years before so I called them in a bit of a panic for one of my out side cats and was so pleased that they answered! 1) Not only did they answer, but
2) ) The person answering the phone was so friendly
3) They had a same day appt, 4) Were willing to be flexible if I didn't catch the (outdoor) cat for the appt, and 5) Welcomed me in with smiles (unlike my previous vet). They then 6) Called me in right at the appt time, 7) Listened to all my concerns about my cat, took him back and did all the things he needed, 8) Then the doctor explained everything and answered all of my questions. I was concerned about price and so 9) They honored those concerns by offering services that my cat really needed rather than services that weren't as essential. And, 10) The pricing was great! I am DEFINITELY switching from my current vet to this wonderful vet office! Oh, and they have free parking! If you want a friendly, thorough, knowledgeable, caring vet for your beloved fur baby, this is it!

Staff and Dr MacLeish are great. So attentive, on time , and kind. Great to communicate with, knowledgeable, and very transparent about prices, which is much appreciated.
I’d recommend anyone to go there.
I’ve been to other vets and I’d not look any further after being here. Wish I could give extra stars :)

I can’t say enough about Dr. Clay and all the staff. Brought my senior Chihuahua kitty who has a heart condition and trachea. I have never felt so blessed to have the professionalism, the empathy and understanding for my little love bug. Thank u to all for making me feel happy and relieved to have all of you in my corner!

Staff is extremely caring. I recently came in with my sister to bring in her dog. The tech was so friendly and really seemed to care about Bella. The vet was also really great. Both vet and tech took the time to answer any questions and concerns we may have. Even though Bella was nervous they handled her with a fear free approach. The pricing also wasn’t too bad!

Thank you for your 5-star rating--it means the world to our team and our small business! We appreciate your support and are thrilled to know your experience with us was a positive one. We’re always here to help and we hope to see you again soon!

Completely amazing facility from the moment I called to set up my first appointment with Kylie, & taking my information for my pup, to the sit down portion of the visit with Dr. Clay-Smith & Lela who made me feel extremely welcome. The attention they gave Xinny (my doggo) was top notch as well. I was also able to speak with the director Dr. Melanie about how their facility is ran & what an astounding job everyone is doing, also to learn they’re expanding to be able to service more of their community. I can see why, because once you’ve entered these doors I’m sure it’ll be pretty impossible to leave without wanting to make this your personal vet. Looking forward to our next visit here. Thanks again Team!

Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! We are thrilled to be a part of your pet's continued care and we appreciate you taking the time to support Animal Advocate Pet Hospital. We hope to see you and your again soon!
Great veterinarians and staff! Our trusted animal advocates in West Loop.
Exceptional staff and vets. Kind, smart and great communication all at a very reasonable price. Already recommended to three friends!
The vet and vet techs took great care of our nervous dog. They made her, and us, as comfortable as possible.

we took our sweet little orange cat in today and had such a great experience. the staff, kylie, and dr. stefanie were exceptional and very friendly and were showering our boy with love. they were very up front about all of the costs of procedures, and very patient throughout the process. we spent hardly any time waiting and all of us were treated very well!

I brought my cats here for 4 years.. I am not going back. Last yearly checkup and vaccination visit they returned 1 of my cats in visible pain and distress, there was big poop in the carrier, and i can only assume how it got there... 1 week and nearing $20k of surgeries and intensive care at VEG and then MedVet, my cat is still hanging in limbo, maybe will require 2nd surgery, and I can't help but wonder what happened to him at AAPH..

I highly recommend Animal Advocate Pet Hospital! My pet, my husband, and I received gentle, caring treatment where every step of the treatment and expenses were discussed and well-informed. The team is very professional, the environment is clean and pleasant, and the veterinarians are qualified with serious and excellent work. Thank you for everything!

AAPH is AMAZING! I was seen by USDA accredited vet, Dr. Clay-Smith who is nothing short of INCREDIBLE, but the whole staff there is wonderful. They are affordable, do not pressure you into services, and explain everything thoroughly in terms you can understand.

My case was a bit complicated - I was moving to Scotland via Amsterdam, and needed a UK and an EU health certificate. Dr. Clay-Smith walked me through the whole process, and the one thing I’ll always remember is that she said, “We’re in this together,” and we were. She called me, answered any questions, and her knowledge made me feel so much better about the process. I got the certificates without issues.

I wholeheartedly recommend AAPH. My only regret is not going there sooner, so I encourage anyone with pets to go!
Knowledgeable, transparent and kind. My cat is in good hands.

I’ve been bringing my cat, Floyd, here for care. Everyone from the front desk to the vet techs have been amazing.

My cat got sick and had to visit urgent care this past Thursday. Animal Advocate followed up with me the next day to see how Floyd was doing and ensured to follow up with a question I had. Unfortunately, I did have to take him to the ER Sunday because his health declined. At his visit to an ER they tried to place a black mask on top of his face and he became very aggressive with staff. They discharged him without doing any diagnostics or examinations.

I scheduled a follow up and we saw Dr. Clay-Smith yesterday. She was so sweet to my cat and handled him with care. Dr. Clay-Smith with the help of one of the vet techs was able to do an examination and draw labs with ease. She answered all of my questions confidently and explained follow up steps thoroughly.

This was my first time visiting. My three year-old cat got really sick and I just wanna say that the staff and the doctors were so nice. They really care about our babies or animals and I know the bill was going to be an expensive and they helped me out so much so that my cat can get better. I recommend this place for everybody. They are very helpful And they take care of your animals with love and I am happy I found them. I know I will be coming back when any of my cats get sick. Thank you to everyone at animal advocate pet Hospital. You guys are wonderful and I wanna say thank you very much.

My senior dog loves this place
She seems at ease and they are very attentive and friendly. Definitely recommend them

Dr. Macleish, Ryan, Toni, and staff on 3/26/2025 treated me, my furbaby Dakota, and family with great care.  it was great to see that there are still good vets out here that do not treat you like you are not important because you don't have alot of money, which is what I have encountered with his prior vet office. The staff at Animal advocate Pet hospital are very caring, helpful, strong communication during our appt as well as after.   I am trying my best to stay with animal advocate going forward because I know that he will be in great hands.

I love this place and the staff but I think it’s unacceptable to wait an hour for our vaccine clinic appointments when there is another staff member available to help but is only taking in specific appointments. Especially when it was raining hail outside! Two other pet owners came in after us and left before us! Lela could have started on our cats appointment while Jo finished her other appointment but instead she would only wait around for other appointments arriving. Jo was a great help and very sweet and apologetic but there definitely needs to be more help and teamwork going on here!

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are glad to know you had a positive experience. If there’s ever anything more we can do for you and your pet, don’t hesitate to reach out. We look forward to seeing you both again soon!

Animal Advocate Pet Hospital is HANDS DOWN the BEST!!!!!!! They take the best care of my girl, Nova, a South African Boerboel. The staff is so friendly caring and accommodating!!!! Nova  does NOTTT like  going to the  vet but is soo sweet with the staff and seems to be less stressed out when visiting this amazing team!!!! They work with your budget and are very informative. They explain things in a way you can understand and never try and scam you like other vets could or  overprice their services! I would recommend them EVERY TIME !  Nova and I love them!
They improved Cocos quality of life forever thankful
Thank you for the 5 stars! As a small, locally owned practice, every bit of support means the world to us. We’re so glad to have you and your pet as part of the Animal Advocate community!
Very transparent with their pricing and affordable, parking in the back

This used to be our go-to vet, but unfortunately, our experience has drastically changed over the past six months. It seems like the entire staff has been replaced, and with that, the level of service has significantly declined. Appointments are rarely on time, and it’s become frustratingly difficult to get in touch with anyone by phone. Most concerning, however, is the decline in the quality of care our dog is receiving. We’ve made the difficult decision not to return.

Called in for an appointment Friday and was
Given an appointment for that evening.Took my cat for a check up as she just had kittens and I was worried about her being so thin. I arrived at my appointment time was placed in a room staff was nice and attentive shortly after Dr walked in. She listened to my concerns and did the necessary test. I was provided with cost prior to confirming care. Cost was very affordable I’m a cat mom of 5 so cost was a major factor for me. I was able to get the necessary test and results were emailed to me that night. Definitely going back for future care.
Amazing staff! Definitely love taking our Remy here 🐾 we have been coming here for years! …

We really appreciate the 5-star rating—thank you! As a small team, every review reminds us why we do what we do. We’re honored to be part of your pet’s care and look forward to seeing you both again soon!
Amazing service and care shown for my cat. I will definitely be taking my other cats to this office for all their medical needs.
Absolutely love the staff here. They took such good care of my pups and were always so compassionate.

Thank you so much for the 5-star love! It truly means the world to our team. Every kind gesture—whether a review, a smile, or a tail wag—keeps us going. We’re so grateful to be a part of your pet’s story.

Animal Advocate has been a fantastic experience! My wife and I looked at a few vets around Chicago but ultimately brought our golden retriever puppy here. The vet tech's are extremely friendly and the veterinarians are all knowledgeable and …

I just want to say Thank you to Dr Clay and her staff for always being attentive to me and my pet. I feel welcomed always coming in here for shots or a checkup. My cat always feels comfortable around here and staff is always there to answer …
Takes good care of my pups!

Amazing comforting experience for my cat, Piper, and myself. They were very clear in the process and upfront with cost which helped a lot. The comfort and care was outstanding. The overall experience was stressless! Highly recommend
